item.title: Cleaning and Sealing of Concrete Waves Skatepark
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 7,000 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-16T12:00:00Z
The Council is seeking bids for the undertaking of cleaning, preparation and protective sealing of the concrete surfaces at Newquay Skatepark, Newquay, Cornwall. The purpose of the works is to improve the appearance of the skatepark, remove biological contamination and surface soiling, and provide a protective concrete sealer to enhance durability and reduce future contamination. The Contractor shall allow for all labour, plant, materials, access equipment, traffic/pedestrian management, waste disposal, health and safety measures, and supervision necessary to complete the works.
